Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
Letter of Recommendation
Letter of Recommendation
Our ref: 126
31 Mar 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “School Building — Delhi
Pkg-148” (INR 1.54 Cr), completed on 16 Apr 2022. On the basis of that engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their
conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
Verification: Chandan Khan, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
